rooms.name: Entrance (portico)
rooms.desc: A stone portico. A rusted iron gate shrieks on its hinges; oil lamps hang on chains either side of heavy oak doors.
rooms.dm: The gate is unlocked. The mists close in on anyone who lingers outside.

rooms.name: Entrance (foyer)
rooms.desc: A grand foyer. A shield with a golden windmill on red hangs between portraits of stern nobles. Stained-glass double doors lead on.
rooms.dm: The portraits are long-dead Dursts.

rooms.name: Den of Wolves
rooms.desc: A hunter's den paneled in oak: a stag's head over the hearth, three stuffed wolves, fur-draped chairs, a card table under a chandelier.
rooms.dm: East cabinet locked (DC 15): three crossbows and bolts. North cabinet: cards and wine glasses. A trapdoor in the southwest corner stays hidden until found from below (32).

rooms.name: Main Hall
rooms.desc: A wide hall with a black marble fireplace at one end and a red marble staircase sweeping up at the other. Carved paneling of vines, nymphs and satyrs.
rooms.dm: DC 12 Perception on the paneling: serpents and skulls hidden in the carving. The paneling follows the stair upward.

rooms.name: Cloakroom
rooms.desc: A cloakroom: black cloaks on hooks, a top hat on a high shelf.

rooms.name: Dining Room
rooms.desc: A paneled dining room: a mahogany table for eight laid with gleaming silver and crystal, a painting of an alpine valley, red silk drapes and a hunting tapestry.
rooms.dm: DC 12 Perception on the paneling: twisted faces in the trees and wolves in the leaves. Silver tarnishes, crystal cracks, the painting fades and the tapestry rots if taken from the house.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.desc: A tidy kitchen: shelves of dishes, a worktable with a rolling pin, a domed stone oven. A small door hides a dumbwaiter with a brass bell beside it.
rooms.dm: Dumbwaiter: 2-ft shaft to 7A and 12A; a Small creature fits (DC 10 Acrobatics); holds 200 lb.

rooms.name: Pantry
rooms.desc: A well-stocked pantry.
rooms.dm: The food looks fresh but tastes of nothing.

objects.desc: A wrought-iron gate with a lock on one side. Its hinges are rusted.
objects.dm: Unlocked; the hinges shriek when it opens.

objects.desc: A shield bearing a golden windmill on a red field, flanked by portraits of stern aristocrats.
objects.dm: The Durst family arms. The portraits are long-dead Dursts.

objects.label: Longsword
objects.desc: A longsword hangs above the black marble mantel; a windmill is worked into its hilt.
objects.dm: Nonmagical longsword. The paneling hides serpents and skulls in its carvings (DC 12 Perception).

objects.desc: A sweeping staircase of red marble curls up to the floor above.
objects.dm: Continues to the second and third floors; the carved paneling follows it.

objects.desc: Black cloaks hang from hooks; a top hat rests on a high shelf.
A stag's head glowers from above the hearth.

container.contents: A heavy, a light and a hand crossbow, with twenty bolts for each.
A small box holding a deck of playing cards, and rows of wine glasses.

objects.label: Locked east cabinet: crossbows (DC 15)
objects.desc: A locked wooden cabinet.
objects.dm: East cabinet: DC 15 Dexterity (thieves' tools). Heavy, light and hand crossbows with 20 bolts each. The north cabinet is unlocked: playing cards and wine glasses.

objects.label: Hidden trapdoor to 32 (only from below)
objects.dm: Trapdoor in the southwest corner. Cannot be found or opened from this side until the party reaches area 32 below.

objects.desc: A crystal chandelier glitters over a table set with polished silver.
objects.dm: The silver tarnishes and the crystal cracks if taken from the house.

objects.desc: A painting of an alpine valley in a mahogany frame.
objects.dm: Fades if removed from the house.

objects.desc: A tapestry of hounds and mounted nobles hunting a wolf.
objects.dm: Rots if removed from the house.

objects.desc: A stone oven shaped like a dome, its bent iron stovepipe running into the ceiling.
objects.dm: Behind and left of the stove is the dumbwaiter door.

objects.desc: A small door opens onto a stone shaft with a wooden box on ropes.
objects.dm: 2-ft shaft to 7A and 12A; a Small creature can ride it (DC 10 Acrobatics). Rope holds 200 lb. A bell rings here when a button upstairs is pressed.

objects.label: Party spawn: portico (Rose & Thorn wait here)

rooms.name: Library
rooms.desc: A library in red velvet: a mahogany desk facing the hearth, a painting of a windmill on a crag, overstuffed chairs, shelves to the ceiling with a rolling ladder.
rooms.dm: Desk drawer: iron key to 20. Secret door behind a shelf: a red book with a blank spine is the switch (DC 13); it swings shut unless propped. Books rot if removed.

rooms.name: Secret Room
rooms.desc: A hidden study lined with shelves of occult books. A skeleton in leather armor sprawls over a clawed chest.
rooms.dm: Books on fiend summoning and the Priests of Osybus, all bogus (1 hour + DC 12 Arcana). Dart trap is spent. The letter from Strahd is the trigger that opens the stair (21). Chest: blank books, three scrolls, deeds, the will.

rooms.name: Servants' Room
rooms.desc: A plain bedroom with two straw-mattress beds and a footlocker at each foot.
rooms.dm: The footlockers are empty. A button by the dumbwaiter rings the kitchen bell.

rooms.name: Servants' Closet
rooms.desc: A closet of neatly hung servants' uniforms.

rooms.name: Upper Hall
rooms.desc: An elegant upper hall: a family portrait over the mantel, suits of wolf-helmed armor beside carved doors. A cold draft spills down the stairs.
rooms.dm: The mother in the portrait eyes the baby with scorn. DC 12 Perception on the doors: the dancing youths are fighting off bats.

rooms.name: Conservatory
rooms.desc: A conservatory: gossamer drapes, a brass chandelier, chairs along the walls, stained glass of singers and players, a harpsichord and a tall harp.
rooms.dm: Some mantel figurines are skeletons in fine clothes.

objects.desc: Floor-to-ceiling shelves of books, with a rolling ladder.
objects.dm: Hundreds of tomes on history, warfare, alchemy, poetry. One red-covered book with a blank spine is a switch (DC 13 Perception): it opens the secret door to 9.

container.contents: An iron key in the drawer. On the desk: an oil lamp, ink and quill, a tinderbox and a letter kit with a windmill seal.

objects.label: Desk drawer: iron key to area 20
objects.desc: A mahogany desk with an oil lamp, ink, quill, tinderbox and a letter kit.
objects.dm: The drawer holds an iron key that unlocks the door to area 20. The wooden seal bears the windmill.

objects.label: Chest: Strahd's letter, deeds, will (dart trap spent)
objects.desc: A heavy chest with clawed iron feet, lid half open. A skeleton in leather armor is slumped over it, three darts in its ribs.
objects.dm: Dart trap is spent. The skeleton clutches a letter under Strahd's seal. Inside: three blank black books (25 gp each), scrolls of bless, protection from poison and spiritual weapon, the deeds to the house and to a windmill, and the Dursts' will.

container.contents: Three blank books bound in black leather, three spell scrolls, the deed to this house, the deed to a windmill, and a signed will.

objects.desc: Shelves of tomes about summoning fiends and a cult's rites.
objects.dm: The rituals are bogus (1 hour of study + DC 12 Arcana).

objects.desc: A suit of armor with a wolf's-head visor, spear in hand.
objects.dm: Decorative. The doors it flanks are carved with dancers who, on inspection (DC 12), are fighting off bats.

objects.desc: A suit of armor with a wolf's-head visor, spear in hand.
objects.dm: Decorative. The doors it flanks are carved with dancers who, on inspection (DC 12), are fighting off bats.

objects.desc: A suit of armor with a wolf's-head visor, spear in hand.
objects.dm: Decorative. The doors it flanks are carved with dancers who, on inspection (DC 12), are fighting off bats.

objects.desc: A suit of armor with a wolf's-head visor, spear in hand.
objects.dm: Decorative. The doors it flanks are carved with dancers who, on inspection (DC 12), are fighting off bats.

objects.label: Durst family portrait (the swaddled baby)
objects.desc: A wood-framed family portrait above the mantel: a man, a woman and two smiling children; the father cradles a swaddled baby.
objects.dm: The mother regards the baby with scorn: Walter, the nursemaid's stillborn child.

objects.desc: A harpsichord and bench.
A tall standing harp.
Alabaster figurines of dancers line the mantelpiece.
objects.dm: Several are carved as well-dressed skeletons.

rooms.name: Master Bedroom
rooms.desc: A dusty master bedroom: a curtained four-poster, two wardrobes, a vanity, a rotting tiger-skin rug before the hearth, a small parlor with a bowl and jug.
rooms.dm: Jewelry box: three gold rings and a topaz necklace (750 gp). Mirror door to the closet (12B). Dumbwaiter button rings the kitchen.

rooms.name: Closet
rooms.desc: An empty closet thick with dust.

rooms.name: Balcony (back)
rooms.desc: A balcony over the back of the house, lost in mist.

rooms.name: Bathroom
rooms.desc: A dark bathroom: a clawed wooden tub, an iron stove with a kettle, a barrel under a wall spigot.
rooms.dm: The rooftop cistern plumbing no longer works.

rooms.name: Storage Room
rooms.desc: A storeroom with shelves of folded linens, blankets and old soap. A broom leans against the far wall.
rooms.dm: The broom attacks anyone within 5 ft.

rooms.name: Nursery
rooms.desc: A nursery. A crib hides beneath a hanging black shroud.
rooms.dm: The swaddled bundle inside is empty (the stillborn Walter).

rooms.name: Balcony (front)
rooms.desc: A balcony over the front of the house, behind stained-glass doors.

rooms.name: Balcony (landing)
rooms.desc: A dusty balcony at the top of the red stair. A suit of black plate armor stands against the wall under cobwebs.
rooms.dm: The armor animates at 5 ft or when damaged. DC 12 Perception on the paneling: tiny corpses in the trees, worms from the soil. Secret door west (DC 15) to the attic stair.

rooms.name: Nursemaid's Bedroom
rooms.desc: A once-elegant bedroom under dust: a large bed, end tables, a wardrobe and a tall mirror framed in carved ivy.
rooms.dm: The nursemaid's specter appears when the nursery door opens. DC 12 on the mirror: eyeballs among the berries. Secret door behind it (DC 15) to the attic stair.

objects.label: Secret door to the attic stair (DC 15)

objects.desc: A four-poster bed hung with embroidered curtains and rotting gossamer veils.

container.contents: Dusty drawers; the jewelry box sits on top.

objects.label: Jewelry box: rings, topaz necklace
objects.desc: A vanity with a mirror and a silver jewelry box.
objects.dm: Box worth 75 gp: three gold rings (25 gp each) and a platinum necklace with a topaz pendant (750 gp).

container.contents: Three gold rings and a thin platinum necklace with a topaz pendant.

objects.desc: A rotting tiger-skin rug before the fireplace.
A dust-covered portrait of a man and a woman above the fireplace.
objects.dm: Gustav and Elisabeth Durst.

objects.desc: A wooden tub on clawed feet; a kettle sits on a small stove.
A barrel under a spigot in the wall.
objects.dm: The rooftop cistern's plumbing no longer works.

objects.label: Broom of animated attack
objects.desc: A cobweb-covered broom leaning against the far wall.
objects.dm: Broom of animated attack. Attacks anything within 5 ft.

objects.desc: A crib covered by a hanging black shroud.
objects.dm: Under the shroud: a tightly wrapped, baby-sized bundle. It is empty.

objects.label: Animated armor (attacks within 5 ft)
objects.desc: A suit of black plate armor stands against the wall, draped in cobwebs.
objects.dm: Animated armor. Attacks when damaged or approached within 5 ft; fights until destroyed.

objects.label: Full-length mirror, ivy frame (eyeballs in the berries)
objects.desc: A full-length mirror in a frame carved with ivy and berries.
objects.dm: DC 12 Perception: eyeballs among the berries. The wall behind it holds a secret door (DC 15) to the attic stair.

objects.label: Specter (nursemaid) — when the nursery door opens
objects.dm: The nursemaid's specter. Manifests when the nursery door (15B) opens, unless already destroyed in 18. Cannot speak or be reasoned with.

rooms.name: Spare Bedroom
rooms.desc: A web-filled spare room: bed, nightstand, rocking chair, wardrobe, stove.

rooms.name: Children's Room
rooms.desc: A children's room with a bricked-up window between two small beds, a toy chest painted with windmills and a dollhouse copy of this house.
rooms.dm: Two small skeletons in familiar clothes lie on the floor. Disturbing the chest or dollhouse calls Rose and Thorn's ghosts. DC 15 on the dollhouse reveals every secret door.

rooms.name: Secret Stairs
rooms.desc: A narrow wooden spiral stair in a stone shaft, thick with cobwebs.
rooms.dm: Cobwebs cut sight to 5 ft. The shaft exists only once the house reveals it; it descends 50 ft to 22.

rooms.name: Attic Hall
rooms.desc: A bare attic hall choked with dust.
rooms.dm: The door to 20 is padlocked: key in the library desk, or DC 15 thieves' tools.

rooms.name: Storage Room
rooms.desc: A storeroom packed with furniture under dusty sheets: chairs, coat racks, mirrors, dress forms.
rooms.dm: Trunk by the stove: the nursemaid's remains (DC 14 Medicine: stabbed many times). Disturbing them brings the specter. A secret door east appears only after 9's letter or 20's dollhouse.

rooms.name: Spare Bedroom
rooms.desc: A cobwebbed spare room: a narrow bed, a writing desk and stool, a stove, a rocking chair. A smiling doll in yellow lace sits in the window.

objects.label: Secret door to the spiral stair (appears after 9 or 20)
Rose & Thorn: skeletal remains + doll
objects.desc: Two small skeletons in tattered clothes lie in the middle of the floor. The smaller one cradles a stuffed doll.
objects.dm: Rose and Thorn. Placing their remains in crypts 23E and 23F lays the ghosts to rest.

objects.label: Toy chest
objects.desc: A toy chest painted with windmills.
objects.dm: Stuffed animals and toys. Disturbing it summons the ghosts.

objects.label: Dollhouse: reveals all secret doors (DC 15)
objects.desc: A dollhouse that is a perfect replica of this house.
objects.dm: DC 15 Perception reveals every secret door in the house, including the attic spiral stair (21). Disturbing it summons the ghosts.

objects.label: Rose (ghost)
objects.dm: Ghost, Small, lawful good, 35 hp, no Horrifying Visage, CR 3. Fights only in self-defense; may possess a character who tries to leave.

objects.label: Thorn (ghost)
objects.dm: Ghost, Small, lawful good, 35 hp, no Horrifying Visage, CR 3. Fights only in self-defense; may possess a character who tries to leave.

objects.desc: A narrow, creaking wooden spiral stair in a stone shaft, choked with cobwebs.
objects.dm: 5-ft shaft, 50 ft down to area 22. Visibility 5 ft. Exists only after the party reads Strahd's letter (9) or finds the dollhouse's secret door (20).

objects.label: Trunk: nursemaid's remains (specter if disturbed)
objects.desc: A wooden trunk under a dusty sheet, beside an iron stove.
objects.dm: Unlocked. The nursemaid's skeleton wrapped in a bloodstained sheet (DC 14 Medicine: stabbed). Disturbing it summons her specter unless destroyed in 15.

container.contents: A woman's bones wrapped in a tattered sheet stiff with old blood.
A few sheets of yellowed paper.

objects.desc: A smiling doll in a lacy yellow dress sits in the window box, cobwebs draping it like a veil.

rooms.name: Cult Initiates' Quarters
rooms.desc: A table and four chairs at one end; moldy straw pallets in alcoves at the other.

rooms.name: Well and Cultist Quarters
rooms.desc: A stone-lipped well drops into darkness; a bucket hangs from a pulley on the beams. Small rooms open off the chamber.
rooms.dm: Well: 30 ft to a cistern. Each side room has a bed and a padlocked chest (DC 15).

rooms.name: Cultist Quarters A
rooms.desc: A moldy bed and a padlocked chest.
rooms.dm: Chest: 11 gp and 60 sp in a human-skin pouch.

rooms.name: Cultist Quarters B
rooms.desc: A moldy bed and a padlocked chest.
rooms.dm: Chest: three moss agates (10 gp each).

rooms.name: Cultist Quarters C
rooms.desc: A moldy bed and a padlocked chest.
rooms.dm: Chest: eyepatch with a carnelian (50 gp).

rooms.name: Cultist Quarters D
rooms.desc: A moldy bed and a padlocked chest.
rooms.dm: Chest: ivory hairbrush with silver bristles (25 gp).

rooms.name: Cultist Quarters E
rooms.desc: A moldy bed and a padlocked chest.
rooms.dm: Chest: silvered shortsword (110 gp).

rooms.name: Dungeon Level Access
rooms.desc: The spiral stair ends in an earthen chamber. A narrow tunnel runs south, then branches.
rooms.dm: A faint chant echoes from somewhere; its source is unclear until 26 or 29.

rooms.name: Family Crypts
rooms.desc: Crypts hewn into the earth, sealed with stone slabs.
rooms.dm: Moving a slab: DC 15 Athletics (advantage with a crowbar). Laying Rose and Thorn's remains in 23E/23F puts them to rest.

rooms.name: Empty Crypt
rooms.desc: An empty crypt; its blank slab leans nearby.

rooms.name: Walter's Crypt
rooms.desc: An empty crypt; its slab, leaning nearby, bears a name.
rooms.dm: Walter Durst.

rooms.name: Gustav's Crypt
rooms.desc: An empty coffin on a stone bier.
rooms.dm: Gustav Durst's crypt.

rooms.name: Elisabeth's Crypt
rooms.desc: An empty coffin on a stone bier.
rooms.dm: Elisabeth Durst's crypt. Centipedes boil out of the wall if the coffin is disturbed.

rooms.name: Rose's Crypt
rooms.desc: An empty coffin on a stone bier.
rooms.dm: Rose's crypt: her remains here lay her ghost to rest.

rooms.name: Thorn's Crypt
rooms.desc: An empty coffin on a stone bier.
rooms.dm: Thorn's crypt: his remains here lay his ghost to rest.

rooms.name: Dining Hall
rooms.desc: A plain table between long benches. Moldy human bones litter the floor.
rooms.dm: Anyone within 5 ft of the dark alcove (28) provokes the grick.

rooms.name: Larder
rooms.desc: A dark alcove.
rooms.dm: A grick lurks here; passive Perception under 12 is surprised.

rooms.name: Hidden Spiked Pit
rooms.desc: A tunnel west. The chanting grows louder.
rooms.dm: DC 15 Perception: no footprints here. Hidden spiked pit: 1d6 + 2d10 to the first to step on it.

rooms.name: Stairs Down
rooms.desc: A 20-ft stair leading down. The chanting clearly rises from below.

rooms.name: Ghoulish Encounter
rooms.desc: A four-way tunnel crossing. The chant is louder to the north.
rooms.dm: At the midpoint, four ghouls rise from the ground and fight to the end.

rooms.name: Hidden Trapdoor (stair)
rooms.desc: A stone stair up to a landing under a low ceiling of planks with a bolted trapdoor.
rooms.dm: Opens into the den (3); once found it stays usable.

rooms.name: Darklord's Shrine
rooms.desc: A shrine hung with shackled skeletons. In an alcove stands a painted statue of a gaunt, pale man in a black cloak, one hand on a wolf, the other holding a grey crystal orb.
rooms.dm: Touching the statue or taking the orb raises five shadows. Concealed door east under clay (DC 10) to the stair (32).

rooms.name: Cult Leaders' Den
rooms.desc: A den with a chandelier over a table, two high-backed chairs, a clay jug and flagons, iron candlesticks.
rooms.dm: The door in the southwest corner is a mimic: it sticks to whoever touches it.

rooms.name: Cult Leaders' Quarters
rooms.desc: A bedroom: a rotted feather bed, a wardrobe of old robes, candlesticks, a crate of torches and candles, a footlocker at the bed's foot.
rooms.dm: Removing anything from the footlocker frees two ghasts from the walls (Gustav and Elisabeth). Footlocker: cloak of protection, four healing potions, spellbook and gear.

objects.label: Concealed door under clay (DC 10) to the stair (32)

objects.desc: A well with a 3-ft stone lip; a bucket hangs from a rope and pulley bolted to the beams.
objects.dm: 4 ft across, 30 ft down to a water-filled cistern.

objects.label: Padlocked chest A (DC 15)
objects.desc: A padlocked wooden chest.
objects.dm: DC 15 Dex (thieves' tools). 11 gp and 60 sp in a pouch of human skin.

container.contents: Worthless odds and ends, and a coin pouch made of an unsettling pale leather.

objects.label: Padlocked chest B (DC 15)
objects.desc: A padlocked wooden chest.
objects.dm: DC 15. Three moss agates (10 gp each) in black cloth.

container.contents: Worthless odds and ends, and three mossy green stones folded in black cloth.

objects.label: Padlocked chest C (DC 15)
objects.desc: A padlocked wooden chest.
objects.dm: DC 15. A leather eyepatch set with a carnelian (50 gp).

container.contents: Worthless odds and ends, and a black leather eyepatch with a red stone sewn into it.

objects.label: Padlocked chest D (DC 15)
objects.desc: A padlocked wooden chest.
objects.dm: DC 15. An ivory hairbrush with silver bristles (25 gp).

container.contents: Worthless odds and ends, and an ivory hairbrush with silver bristles.

objects.label: Padlocked chest E (DC 15)
objects.desc: A padlocked wooden chest.
objects.dm: DC 15. A silvered shortsword (110 gp).

container.contents: Worthless odds and ends, and a silvered shortsword.

objects.desc: The wooden spiral stair ends here in an earthen chamber.
objects.dm: Up to 21 (the attic).

objects.dm: Gustav's crypt. Slab: DC 15 Athletics to remove (advantage with a crowbar).

objects.desc: An empty coffin on a stone bier.
objects.dm: Elisabeth's crypt. A swarm of insects (centipedes) bursts from the back wall if the coffin is disturbed.

objects.desc: An empty coffin on a stone bier.
objects.dm: Rose's crypt. Her remains laid here put her ghost to rest.

objects.desc: An empty coffin on a stone bier.
objects.dm: Thorn's crypt. His remains laid here put his ghost to rest.

objects.desc: A blank stone slab leans against the wall beside an open, empty crypt.
A stone slab etched with a name leans against the wall; the crypt is empty.
objects.dm: Walter Durst.

objects.label: Swarm of insects (if the coffin is disturbed)
Grick (attacks within 5 ft of the alcove)
objects.desc: A dark alcove.
objects.dm: A grick lurks here and attacks the first creature within 5 ft; passive Perception under 12 is surprised.

objects.label: Hidden spiked pit: 5 ft long, 10 ft deep (DC 15 to notice)
objects.desc: Bare earthen floor.
objects.dm: Hidden spiked pit under rotted planks and a skin of dirt: 5 ft long, 10 ft deep. DC 15 Perception notices the missing footprints. Fall: 1d6 bludgeoning + 2d10 piercing, prone.

objects.label: Ghoul 1 (rises from the ground at the midpoint)
objects.dm: One of four ghouls (former cultists) that rise from the ground when the party reaches the midpoint of the crossing. They fight until destroyed.

objects.label: Trapdoor (bolted this side) up to the den (3)
objects.desc: A wooden trapdoor in a low plank ceiling, bolted from this side.
objects.dm: Pushes open into the den (3) above. Once found it stays available as a way in and out.

objects.desc: A painted wooden statue of a gaunt, pale-faced man in a voluminous black cloak, his left hand on the head of a wolf, a smoky crystal orb in his right.
objects.dm: Strahd. Touching the statue or taking the orb summons five shadows that pursue beyond the room. The orb is worth 25 gp and works as an arcane focus.

objects.label: Shadow 1 (if the statue is touched)
objects.dm: One of five shadows (former cultists) that form around the statue if it is touched.

objects.desc: Moldy skeletons hang from rusty shackles along the walls.
objects.dm: Harmless decor.

objects.label: Mimic disguised as the door
objects.desc: A rotted wooden door.
objects.dm: Mimic. Anything touching it adheres; it attacks when touched or damaged.

objects.desc: An open crate of thirty torches and a sack of fifteen candles.

objects.label: Footlocker: cloak of protection, potions, spellbook
objects.desc: An unlocked footlocker at the foot of the bed.
objects.dm: Cloak of protection, coffer with four potions of healing, chain shirt, mess kit, alchemist's fire, bullseye lantern, thieves' tools, and a wizard's spellbook (1st: disguise self, identify, mage armor, magic missile, protection from evil and good; 2nd: darkvision, hold person, invisibility, magic weapon). Taking anything brings the ghasts out of the walls.

container.contents: A folded cloak, a small coffer with four potions, a chain shirt, a mess kit, a flask of alchemist's fire, a bullseye lantern, thieves' tools and a spellbook bound in yellow leather.

objects.label: Ghast (Gustav Durst) — behind the wall
objects.dm: Gustav Durst, a ghast hidden in a cavity behind the earthen wall. Bursts out if anything is taken from the footlocker.

objects.label: Ghast (Elisabeth Durst) — behind the wall
objects.dm: Elisabeth Durst, a ghast hidden behind the wall. Bursts out with Gustav.

rooms.name: Reliquary
rooms.desc: Thirteen niches of grisly curios. Here the chant resolves into words: 'He is the Ancient. He is the Land.'
rooms.dm: The relics are worthless. The south tunnel slopes into murky water to a portcullis (37).

rooms.name: Prison
rooms.desc: Alcoves with rusty shackles, empty now.
rooms.dm: A robed skeleton in the marked cell wears a gold ring. Secret door south (DC 15) to 38.

rooms.name: Portcullis
rooms.desc: A rusty iron portcullis over 2 ft of murky water.
rooms.dm: DC 20 Athletics to lift, or turn the wheel inside 38.

rooms.name: Ritual Chamber
rooms.desc: A forty-foot hall of smooth stone and pillars, half flooded. Stairs rise to dry ledges and to a central dais with a blood-stained altar under hanging chains. A breach opens west on a heap of refuse.
rooms.dm: The chant stops as they enter. Climbing the dais summons thirteen apparitions: 'One must die!' Refusing wakes Lorghoth (the refuse heap).

objects.label: Secret door to the ritual chamber (DC 15)

objects.desc: Stairs rise to an octagonal stone dais above the water.
objects.dm: 5 ft high; the water is 2 ft deep. Ceiling 16 ft.

objects.desc: A stone altar carved with grasping ghouls, stained with dried blood. Chains and shackles dangle above it.
objects.dm: Climbing the dais summons thirteen harmless apparitions chanting for a sacrifice. A creature must die on the altar, or the cultists rouse Lorghoth.

objects.label: Chains 8 ft long above the altar: prisoners were hung here and bled onto it

objects.desc: A wooden wheel half-embedded in the wall.
objects.dm: An action turns it, raising or lowering the portcullis (37). Out of reach from the far side.

objects.label: Lorghoth the Decayer (shambling mound, asleep)
objects.desc: A half-submerged heap of refuse fills a natural alcove.
objects.dm: Lorghoth the Decayer, a shambling mound, asleep. DC 15 Nature reveals it. Wakes if attacked or if the party refuses the sacrifice; pursues but never leaves the dungeon.
